title: Mai Mercado 2016 — Police Referral Chain Audit
purpose: Reconstruct who initiated, transmitted and formalized the police referral in the June 2016 Christiania/Facebook case, without collapsing parliamentary security, ordinary police, PET, Mercado, third-party Facebook users, and media into one actor.
core_finding: The surviving contemporary accounts do not tell one simple referral story. One Ritzau/TV2 account says Mercado stated she did not herself make the police report and that another Facebook user reported the matter. A contemporaneous Sønderborg courtroom report says Folketingets sikkerhedsafdeling reported the threats after a contact from Mercado. These accounts can coexist only if they describe different roles or different referrals; they should not be flattened into 'a random woman reported it independently of Mercado'.

actors.documented_role: Target of the disputed Facebook comments and originator of the Christiania post. According to the courtroom report, she contacted Folketingets sikkerhedsafdeling. According to TV2/Ritzau, she said she did not personally make the police report.
actors.not_established: No recovered source proves she personally telephoned Syd- og Sønderjyllands Politi or PET to initiate the Son's case.

actors.documented_role: According to SønderborgNYT's courtroom account, this office made the police report after a contact from Mercado.
actors.institutional_note: Parliamentary security is part of Folketinget's security/service structure, not itself the police and not synonymous with PET.

actors.documented_role: Ritzau/Avisen reporting says another Facebook user chose to report the matter to police; an earlier article links a third-party report to a Jo Cox-related comment.
actors.unresolved: Identity, exact reported comment, target defendant and whether this was the same referral as the parliamentary-security report are not recovered.

actors.documented_role: Local police investigated, visited the defendant, arrested/remanded him, seized computer and phone, and later reviewed the material.
actors.not_established: No recovered contemporary source identifies PET as the investigative body in this particular prosecution.

actors.documented_general_role: PET has national person-protection and security responsibilities relating to members of government, Folketinget and other specially threatened persons.
actors.case_status: No case-specific evidence recovered so far shows PET initiated or conducted the Son's June 2016 prosecution.
actors.boundary: Do not label the actors in this case 'political police' as a factual institutional description without case-specific documentation.

actors.documented_role: Reported the controversy and police/court proceedings; source genealogy varies and later reports sometimes rely on earlier outlets rather than independent primary material.

contemporary_accounts.claim: In court it was stated that Folketingets sikkerhedsafdeling had reported the threats after a contact from Mai Mercado.
contemporary_accounts.implication: Mercado appears upstream of at least one formal referral chain even if parliamentary security, rather than Mercado personally, submitted the report to police.

contemporary_accounts.claim: Mercado said she was not the person who made the police report.
contemporary_accounts.implication: This can be technically consistent with the parliamentary-security account if Mercado contacted security and security formally filed the report.

contemporary_accounts.claim: Another Facebook user chose to report the matter to police.
contemporary_accounts.implication: Could represent a separate referral, the original trigger, or source compression. Exact relationship to the parliamentary-security report is unresolved.

contemporary_accounts.claim: An earlier story describes a Facebook user reporting a comment invoking murdered British MP Jo Cox.
contemporary_accounts.implication: The first third-party report may have concerned a specific comment or speaker rather than the entire later case against the Son.

referral_models.model: A — Mercado to parliamentary security to police
referral_models.support: Directly compatible with the courtroom report and Mercado's statement that she did not personally file the police report.

referral_models.model: B — independent Facebook user to police, plus separate Mercado-security contact
referral_models.support: Would reconcile all surviving accounts without anyone necessarily lying.

referral_models.model: C — media conflation of multiple defendants/comments/referrals
sequence: later articles collapse them into a single 'the matter was reported' story
referral_models.support: Consistent with the known multi-speaker thread and later separate prosecutions.

referral_models.model: D — Mercado materially misrepresented her role
sequence: later public statement creates impression of no initiating role
referral_models.support: Possible if both statements concern the same report and defendant and if her wording denied more than personal filing mechanics.

language_analysis.key_distinction: 'I did not make the police report' is narrower than 'I did not initiate, request, trigger or cause any referral to police.'
language_analysis.material_question: What exactly did Mercado tell TV2 in Danish, and did the wording deny only formal filing or deny involvement in initiating the referral?

security_context.parliamentary_security: Folketinget maintains a security/service function for members and the parliamentary estate.
security_context.PET_general: PET is responsible for person-protection tasks for government, Folketinget and other particularly threatened persons.
security_context.case_boundary: General access to institutional security does not itself prove special or improper intervention in this prosecution. The case-specific chain must be shown from records.

judgment.supported: The simplistic narrative that an unrelated Facebook user independently reported everything and Mercado played no upstream role is not securely supported by the surviving record.
judgment.supported_with_caution: The courtroom report gives evidence that Mercado contacted parliamentary security and that this contact resulted in a formal report by that office.
judgment.not_supported_yet: Mercado personally called police, used PET, ordered police action, or abused a special political-police channel.
judgment.investigative_priority: Determine whether the third-party Facebook report and parliamentary-security report were separate referrals, and which exact comments/defendants each concerned.
